subject: english
question:
Select the correct active form.

"By whom is this rule obeyed?"
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence given is in the passive voice: "By whom is this rule obeyed?"
 
• To convert it into active voice, we need to identify the subject and make it the doer of the action.
 
• The passive structure "is obeyed" changes to the active structure "obeys."
 
• The subject of the active voice becomes "Who."
 
• Therefore, the active voice form of the sentence is: "Who obeys this rule?"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Who obeys this rule?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Who is obeying this rule?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous).
 
• **Option 2: **"Who does obey this rule?" – Grammatically incorrect structure.
 
• **Option 4: **"Who has obeyed this rule?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
